item.title: Adult social care complaint letter (free template, England)
item.description: Adult social care complaint letter for families in England. If things have gone wrong with the council's adult social care and asking hasn't fixed it. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Carer's assessment request letter (free template, England)
item.description: Carer's assessment request letter for families in England. For you, if you help look after someone. It's free, whatever your income, and they don't need to be getting council help. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Complaint letter: home care visits cut short or missed (free template, England)
item.description: Complaint letter: home care visits cut short or missed for families in England. If home care visits are shorter than you pay for, late or missed. Send it to the agency's manager. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Complaint letter to a care home or care agency (free template, England)
item.description: Complaint letter to a care home or care agency for families in England. If you're unhappy with the care a home or agency gives. Raise it with the manager first; this makes it formal. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Letter to plan for leaving hospital (free template, England)
item.description: Letter to plan for leaving hospital for families in England. Before someone comes home from hospital, so the right help is in place first. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Tell CQC about poor care: letter template (free template, England)
item.description: Tell CQC about poor care: letter template for families in England. CQC can't settle your complaint, but it uses what you tell it to decide when and where to inspect. Email it, or paste it into CQC's online form at cqc.org.uk/give-feedback-on-care. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Letter asking the council for a care needs assessment (free template, England)
item.description: Letter asking the council for a care needs assessment for families in England. When someone is struggling at home and may need care, equipment or changes to the home. It's free, whatever their savings. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Letter to challenge a council care decision (free template, England)
item.description: Letter to challenge a council care decision for families in England. If you think an assessment, a care plan or a funding decision is wrong. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Letter to question a care home fee increase (free template, England)
item.description: Letter to question a care home fee increase for families in England. If a care home puts its fees up and you don't think it's fair, or it wasn't explained. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: NHS complaint letter (GP or hospital) (free template, England)
item.description: NHS complaint letter (GP or hospital) for families in England. If something went wrong with NHS care. You can complain up to 12 months after it happened. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Letter to report a safeguarding concern (free template, England)
item.description: Letter to report a safeguarding concern for families in England. If you think someone is being neglected or abused, including by carers. If anyone is in danger now, call 999. Free, and fill it in on your phone.

item.title: Subject access request for care records (free template, England)
item.description: Subject access request for care records for families in England. A subject access request for their care plans, daily notes and visit records. It's free, and the reply is due within one month. Free, and fill it in on your phone.
